# id: # Woodcutting methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Chopping regular trees
where: Trees south of the Grand Exchange, west of Lumbridge Castle, or outside Draynor Manor
note: 25 xp per log and 97 logs to reach level 15; the wiki gives no xp/h rate and any axe works (bronze shown)

name: Monk's Friend quest
note: One-off reward of 2,000 Woodcutting xp with no requirements per the UIM guide; membership not stated on the pages
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Pay-to-play Woodcutting training 2026-11-11

name: Enlightened Journey quest
note: One-off reward of 1,500 Woodcutting xp; also needs 20 quest points; membership not stated on the pages
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper quest
note: One-off reward of 4,000 Woodcutting xp; the UIM guide says it requires Gertrude's Cat (GERTRUDES_CAT) while the IM guide lists no requirement; membership not stated on the pages
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: Cutting oak trees
where: Oak trees near Varrock west bank, behind Lumbridge General Store, south of Falador gates, near Port Sarim; UIM uses two oaks one tile apart
note: 37.5 xp per log; 15:20000 is the UIM figure with a steel axe dropping logs and 50:40000 is "over 40,000" at 50+ without tick manipulation; adamant axe up to 29,000 per UIM
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Free-to-play Woodcutting training 2026-11-11

name: Cutting willow trees
where: South-west of the Draynor Village bank (dark wizards nearby), Port Sarim, Lumbridge
note: 67.5 xp per log; xp values are the low end of the F2P guide's non-3-tick ranges (30 with adamant axe, 40 with rune axe), assuming logs are dropped

name: Cutting maple trees
where: Corsair Cove Resource Area (4 trees, far from a bank)
note: 100 xp per log; 36,000 xp/h at level 80 without tick manipulation per the F2P guide; Dragon Slayer I is needed to enter Corsair Cove and The Corsair Curse must be started

name: Cutting yew trees
where: South of the Edgeville bank, behind Varrock Palace, south of the Falador east bank
note: 175 xp per log; the F2P guide recommends willow or maple for xp and yews for money; the 99:47000 rate is from the level-99 rates table in the Pay-to-play page summary, so verify
source: OSRS Wiki Free-to-play Woodcutting training, Pay-to-play Woodcutting training 2026-11-11

name: 1.5-tick teak trees (Fossil Island)
where: Planted teak trees on Fossil Island, next to the hardwood patches
note: Tick manipulation (3-tick cycle, such as swamp tar on a clean herb); table assumes rune axe to 61, dragon felling axe 61-71, crystal felling axe from 71; the crystal felling axe needs Song of the Elves; the page says up to about 255,000 at 99 and 230,000-240,000 sustained; forester's rations are optional
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Woodcutting training, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: 2-tick teak trees (birds or rabbits)
where: Ape Atoll or Isle of Souls using birds; Prifddinas using rabbits
note: Less click-intensive than 1.5-tick; lure birds or rabbits without killing them, then time clicks with auto-retaliate on a no-arrow shortbow on rapid; Ape Atoll jungle spiders are poisonous; table assumes the same axes as 1.5-tick; the page text says up to 223,000 at 99 while the table says 215,000

name: Cutting sulliuscep (Fossil Island Tar Swamp)
where: Tar Swamp, Fossil Island (World 321 is the designated world)
note: No tick manipulation; the 65 figure uses a dragon axe and 71+ use the crystal axe; these values come from the model summary of the truncated Pay-to-play page, so verify; UIM says about 80,000 at 75, 97,000 at 90 and 100,000-110,000 at 99; 97,778 chops from 65 to 99 with the lumberjack outfit
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Woodcutting training, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: Cutting blisterwood trees (Darkmeyer)
where: Darkmeyer (Sins of the Father partly completed)
note: 76 xp per log and the tree never depletes; 1/10 chance per cut to stop, so it is AFK-friendly; the Pay-to-play page gives up to about 69,000 xp/h before 90 and 86,000 with a crystal felling axe and forester's rations, while the UIM guide says about 65,000 before 90; logs give 96 Firemaking xp when burned (UIM)
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Woodcutting training, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: Cutting ironwood trees (Sunbleak Island)
where: Sunbleak Island (14 ironwood trees; bank chest needs Construction 70 per IM summary)
note: 175 xp per set of logs, and the tree falls after 400 ticks; 80:70000 and 99:75000 are UIM figures with a dragon axe dropping logs; a crystal felling axe with forester's rations goes up to 100,000 at 99 (UIM); Forestry events lower rates to about 70,000-90,000 per IM summary
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11

name: Cutting redwood trees (Woodcutting Guild)
note: 380 xp per log per the Pay-to-play table summary; 55,000-60,000 at 90 and about 65,000 at 99 with a dragon or infernal axe per that summary, while UIM says up to about 65,000 with a dragon axe and 75,000-80,000 with a crystal axe; IM guide calls it the best passive method with large AFK downtime; Farming Guild redwood saplings are not recommended for Woodcutting
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Pay-to-play Woodcutting training 2026-11-11

name: Woodcutting bruma roots at Wintertodt
note: Each bruma root chopped gives 0.3 x Woodcutting level xp (UIM guide); the IM guide recommends it for levels 50-60 and getting 60 Woodcutting here to buy a better axe from the Woodcutting Guild; no axe is named on the page; membership not stated on the pages
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting, Ironman Guide/Woodcutting 2026-11-11
